fields.title: The after-hours call that books itself
steps: Burst pipe texts the on-call tech
Routine job gets a morning slot
Call summary lands in your CRM
fields.after: Every caller answered and sorted tonight

caption: Most after-hours calls aren't emergencies, but you can't tell from a voicemail. Let the first question do the sorting, so only real emergencies reach your phone tonight.

fields.title: Intake forms done before the first visit
steps: Intake form link sent by text
Reminder if it's not back in 24h
fields.before: Clipboards and typing at the front desk
fields.after: Paperwork done before they walk in

caption: The first visit shouldn't start with ten minutes of paperwork. This is scheduling and admin only: the form collects contact and booking details, and your clinicians handle everything clinical.

fields.headline: Automate the task you *repeat every single day* first.
fields.sub: Not the fanciest one, the one your office does on autopilot already.

caption: The best first automation is usually boring. Confirmations, callbacks, reminders. Pick the task your team could do in their sleep and let a workflow take it.

fields.title: Quotes that follow up without you
steps: Reply yes and it books the install
No reply? Flagged for one call
fields.before: Quotes sent, then forgotten in the inbox
fields.after: Every quote gets a polite follow-up

caption: A quote with no follow-up is a coin toss. Two light touches and a booking link keep the job warm, and you only pick up the phone for the quiet ones.

fields.title: Ask for the review while the job's fresh
steps: Owner sees replies in one list
fields.before: Reviews only when someone remembers to ask
fields.after: Every finished roof gets a review ask

caption: Happy customers rarely leave reviews on their own. A short text the morning after the job asks at the right moment, and if someone replies with a problem, the office hears about it right away.

fields.headline: Your customers don't want an app. They want *a fast reply.*
fields.sub: A text back in a minute beats a perfect portal nobody logs into.

caption: Small businesses win on speed and simplicity. Before buying another tool, ask how fast a new customer hears back from you, and start there.

fields.title: Recall reminders that fill next month
steps: Patient is due for a cleaning
No reply in a week? Second text
Front desk calls the last few
fields.before: A recall list nobody has time to call
fields.after: Patients book recalls from a text

caption: Recall lists tend to sit until someone has a slow afternoon. A text with a booking link does the first pass, and your team only phones the people who didn't answer. Scheduling admin only.
